data.evidence: Restructure agreed with the repository owner: the entrypoint went from 300 lines to 164 by moving the acceptance detail into references/acceptance.md and compressing the orientation, and the loop now sits on one screen at the top. It also points the agent at generation.brief, a new helper that prints the declared output names with their shapes, the objective direction and every instance field shape - the facts whose extraction by eye cost attempts in earlier runs, and which next_work now uses to withhold pairs no rectangular binder can take.
